units: <cite ref="Chullin 42b:8">Ḥull. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>נעקרה צ׳ מעיקרה</he> if a rib of an animal is torn loose from its seat.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:22">Gen. III, 22</cite>) <he>כל זמן … כאחד וכיון שנטלה צַלְעָתוֹ וכ׳</he> as long as he was Adam, he was like one (harmonious in himself), but when his rib was taken from him, he was ‘to know’ (the conflict between) ‘good and evil’; Yalk. ib. 34.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 6a:3">Kidd. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>צַלְעָתִי מהו</he> if one says to a woman, ‘be thou my rib’ (alluding to <cite ref="Genesis 2:22">Gen. II, 22</cite>), how is it (is this to be recognized as a betrothal)?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְלָעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>נשתברו רוב צַלְעוֹתֶיהָ</he> if the larger number of an animal’s ribs are broken.
Ib. 52ᵃ ובצ׳ גדולות וכ׳ and it means the large ribs, those that have marrow in their bones; a. fr.—2) side of a hill or rock.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 5:4">Shebi. V, 4</cite>; Y. ib. 36ᵃ top <cite ref="R00362"><he>צִילְעוֹת</he></cite> constr., v. <cite ref="Q00151"><he>פּוּאָה</he></cite>.
